locator.original_text: Tongi students lift Dhaka-Mymensingh Highway blockade

text: Tongi students lift Dhaka-Mymensingh Highway blockade

locator.original_text: Students ended their blockade of the Dhaka-Mymensingh Highway in Gazipur's Tongi around 3pm today after police assured them that their demands for foot overbridges would be met.

text: Students ended their blockade of the Dhaka-Mymensingh Highway in Gazipur's Tongi around 3pm today after police assured them that their demands for foot overbridges would be met.

locator.original_text: The students had blocked the highway around 11am at the Asia Pump and Gazipur bus stand, protesting the death of Yasin, 17, a class nine student of Tamirul Millat Kamil Madrasa, in a road accident.

text: The students had blocked the highway around 11am at the Asia Pump and Gazipur bus stand, protesting the death of Yasin, 17, a class nine student of Tamirul Millat Kamil Madrasa, in a road accident.

locator.original_text: The blockade brought buses on the Dhaka-Mymensingh, Dhaka-Kishoreganj and Dhaka-Tangail routes to a standstill, causing suffering for thousands of passengers.

text: The blockade brought buses on the Dhaka-Mymensingh, Dhaka-Kishoreganj and Dhaka-Tangail routes to a standstill, causing suffering for thousands of passengers.

locator.original_text: Shafikur Rahman, an inspector of Gazipur Traffic Police, said the students demanded the immediate construction of foot overbridges at the two locations.

text: Shafikur Rahman, an inspector of Gazipur Traffic Police, said the students demanded the immediate construction of foot overbridges at the two locations.

locator.original_text: Protesters were seen carrying banners and festoons, including one that read, “Foot overbridges must be constructed immediately.”

text: Protesters were seen carrying banners and festoons, including one that read, “Foot overbridges must be constructed immediately.”

locator.original_text: Personnel from Tongi East and Tongi West police stations were deployed at the scene and tried to persuade the students to withdraw the blockade.

text: Personnel from Tongi East and Tongi West police stations were deployed at the scene and tried to persuade the students to withdraw the blockade.

locator.original_text: Although the blockade has been lifted, traffic on the highway has yet to return to normal, with congestion persisting following the hours-long protest.

text: Although the blockade has been lifted, traffic on the highway has yet to return to normal, with congestion persisting following the hours-long protest.

locator.original_text: Attempts to contact Tamirul Millat Kamil Madrasa Principal Mohammad Hifzur Rahman by phone were unsuccessful as he did not answer the calls.

text: Attempts to contact Tamirul Millat Kamil Madrasa Principal Mohammad Hifzur Rahman by phone were unsuccessful as he did not answer the calls.
